//: Local PolyScope X simulator (a UR10e) plus the real wrist camera. ONE server: 'case 1/run_server.sh' with no host argument stays on 127.0.0.1, pins UR_MODEL=ur10e, and launches case 1/server.py with UR_VISION=1 so case 1/camera's tools mount into it -- 59 tools from one MCP. Paths are RELATIVE to the repo root, so this file works on any clone. macOS only: librealsense needs root for the D435, so there set command to '/usr/bin/sudo' and prepend '-n' to args; on Linux the udev rules make that unnecessary. Copy this over .mcp.json and restart Claude Code.
